column1: # How much each metric counts in the wf-bench score (issue #452).
# metric<TAB>weight. The score is the weighted geometric mean of each metric's
# Wayfinder/Solr ratio (inverted for throughput), so below 1.0 = Wayfinder wins.
# A metric measured per query shape or load level is first averaged (geomean)
# across them, so it counts once. Every metric wf-bench scores must be listed
# here, and nothing else. Left out on purpose: the disk-cache memory figures
# Per query shape, warm, timed requests.
# The same URL repeated, so caches are hot.
# First request of each shape right after indexing.
# First request of each shape after a restart with an empty page cache.
# Searches at once, per concurrency level.
